profile.name: BioShake微孔板加热振荡器
profile.description: 这是一种实验室微孔板加热振荡器，可对板式样品进行控温并同时振荡混匀。它常用于样品孵育、反应混合、酶反应、核酸与蛋白相关实验等需要稳定温度和持续摇匀的流程，部分机型还支持锁板与主动冷却功能。
profile.description_en: This is a laboratory microplate heater shaker that provides temperature control and shaking for plate-based samples. It is commonly used for sample incubation, reaction mixing, enzymatic workflows, and nucleic acid or protein-related assays that require stable heating and continuous agitation. Some models also support plate locking and active cooling.

registry.name: BioShake iQ Microplate Shaker
registry.description: BioShake iQ Microplate Shaker 恒温摇床是由Q.Instruments (Analytik Jena)生产的恒温摇床，主要功能包括停止、冷却、复位、归零、温度设置、电流读取。
